high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie in an urban setting at night. The individual is wearing a black T-shirt with the text "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" prominently displayed across the chest in large, bold letters. Below the main text, there is a badge that reads "Brooklyn Police Department" and "NINE NINE," along with additional smaller text that appears to be part of the design.
